content.title: Chapter 22 - BUSINESSES — Sec. 22-134. - Installation without permit.
content.summary:
The installation, operation or maintenance of a community antenna television system
               without a permit therefor as provided in this division is declared to be a nuisance
               and a trespass upon the public property.
(Code 1960, § 7A-5; Code 1981, § 9-5)
